Zayıf yönü asla yok. Normalde stüdyo hocalarında olmayan öğrenciye saygı, anlayış, özveri ise bol bol var. İlk kez 3.sınıf stüdyosu verdiği halde, fazlasıyla profesyonelce ve doğru şekilde yönlendiren sistemli biri Maysam Hoca. Akşam dokuzlara kadar kalıp kritik verecek kadar ilgili aynı zamanda. Ne olursa olsun hep destek oldu bize, sınıf bazında da bireysel olarak da; çünkü bizlerin birer robot değil de insan olduğumuzun farkındaydı. Daha önceki dönemlerde gelişmediğim kaadar geliştim kendi adıma, hep destek oldu bu konuda da. Hatta şöyle ifade edeyim, beni üzen tek şey bu dönemin bitmesi oldu çünkü bir sonraki dönem Maysam Hocanın 3.sınıf stüdyosu vermeyeceğini öğrendik. Dönem olarak Maysam Hocadan ders alabilme şansımızın olmaması bence çok büyük bir kayıp. Şunu da eklemk istiyorum, bu dönem Maysam Hocanın öğrencisi olmak başıma gelen en güzel şeylerden biriydi, büyük bir şanstı benim için.

Maysam Hoca is the best person that we have ever met, both in personal aspect and as an instructor. From the beginning of the course to the end, he had given so much effort on us. He cares all of his students and gives critiques in a very helpful and detailed way. Since he cares all of the projects that we do, in every class he spends so much time in studio and tries to inspire us. The critiques that he gives are very nice,  helpful and clear. He cares all of the ideas and improves them with respecting his students.  Sometimes we feel that he knows our ideas more than we know, because he interests our ideas more than we interest. He never wants to discourage somebody or break somebody's hearth, therefore when he does not share a same design idea with a student, he says it in a very very kind way. When he see a students who does not work enough, he tries to inspire him / her. At the same sime, he always preserves "good student-instructor relationship."  Sometimes some of the students abuse his goodwill  but we can see that he always wants to be fair for all students. Also he always helps us in order to improve our not only design ideas, but also computer skills, hand-drawings and presentation techniques.  In every juries, he introduces us with architects that we can consult and get advices for our projects. In every class day, we can see how much he feels tired because of allowing long times for each student individually. He also helps students who are even not in his class. He loves his profession and wants to improve both himself and students. He is one if the biggest reason that we can stand this tiring juries and doing projects voluntarily. Before this course, I was thinking to quit studying architecture because of I feel so tired, but he cause me to love architecture again. We feel very sad about that he will not attend ARCH 302 studio next semester. From our perspective, Maysam Hoca was one of the best instructors in architectural studio courses and in Bilkent.

He is really lovely and wanted to help all of the students. But I think he was not good at time management at all. We sometimes had to wait until 7-8 pm to get critics so I wish he could manage it better. Also I think he is not so good at giving critics. Overall he is a helping, good teacher.

Every architectural design studios are very very very tiring. From the beginning of the course, at least 3 days in a week we have to work till the morning in order to catch up the course. If you does not spend time till the morning, you won't be able to be a successful student in this course. This is not because of instructor but because of the system of the course. Because of studying for ARCH 302, we cannot allow time for our other courses, or the topics that we want to research, or the subjects that we want to improve ourselves. There are too much juries and presentation regulations that make everything more difficult for us. Also we spend so much money for this course, especially for coloured prints and making models. Also we need so much computer technologies (such as Rhino, Photoshop, etc) which are so expensive for a student but Bilkent does not help student in these issues.
